title: Bread on the Water
text: A loaf, still warm, floats toward you down a black stream, wrapped in a clean white cloth. Steam rises from it. There is no mill upstream, no house, no oven for miles, and nothing else in the water is clean.

options.label: Share it out among you, and ask no questions of a gift this strange.

outcomes.text: It tastes of a kitchen none of you have ever stood in. Someone, somewhere, wanted you to live. For now, at least.
